scope: New store catalog only. Existing marketplace collectibles, contracts, ownership, rarity and edition limits are unchanged.
allocationMeaning: Percentages are shares of proposed lifetime supply, not drop odds, probabilities, discounts or guaranteed revenue.
approvalPolicy: Planning proposal only. No contract configuration, mint right, purchase availability or game entitlement is created; final edition assignments and caps require explicit approval.
purchaseGrant: One purchased unit grants one selected color edition, never all nine colors.

inventoryRules.availableFormula: approved cap minus lifetime minted units minus outstanding unique reservations; enforce both edition and product caps
inventoryRules.reservationSettlement: Converting a reservation to a mint consumes its reserved slot once; expiry releases only the unminted reservation.

raritySource.supplyPercentStatus: New proposal; not inherited from salvage drops or shard allocations

assignmentMethod: Explicit persisted product/variant identities selected by category finish and original neutral color priority. Runtime lookup never hashes, sorts or automatically assigns new catalog entries.
